content.description: Propeller shaft assembly mounted on support stands showing full shaft length with propeller and intermediate sections

content.text: 1. INSPECT PROPELLER AND INTERMEDIATE SHAFTS FOR DAMAGE OR RUNOUT
If shaft runout is greater than maximum, replace the shaft.

content.description: Close-up view of spider bearing being inspected by hand, showing yoke and bearing assembly

items: (a) Inspect the spider bearings for wear or damage.
(b) Check the spider bearing axial play by turning the yoke while holding the shaft tightly.

content.text: If necessary, replace the propeller shaft.

content.description: Hands inspecting center support bearing assembly, showing bearing housing and mounting bracket

content.text: 3. INSPECT CENTER SUPPORT BEARING FOR WEAR OR DAMAGE
Check that the bearing turns freely.
If the bearing is damaged, worn, or does not turn freely, replace it.
